name: a-background-audio-tab-gets-a-controller
description:
The sidebar media controller block. AtriumMediaHub pushes one record per tab that plays media, and the block draws one controller for each of them under the tab list.

build/scenarios/fixtures holds no media file, so nothing in the VM can make a tab play. The records are pushed straight into the surface through window.atriumMediaSessionsChanged, which is the same entry point the browser calls - a fake record proves the block, not the hub. atrium_media_hub_browsertest.cc owns the hub half.

Measures what the unit suite cannot: the real height of a controller, that the block clears the space dots bar under it, that the live theme resolves a fill and an ink for it, and that a button reaches chrome.send in the real document.

actions.expression: (() => { window.atriumMediaSessionsChanged([{id:'98',title:'Older Track',faviconURL:'',host:'one.example',playing:true,muted:false,canPrev:false,canNext:true,canSeek:false,pictureInPicture:false},{id:'99',title:'Newer Track',faviconURL:'',host:'two.example',playing:true,muted:false,canPrev:true,canNext:true,canSeek:false,pictureInPicture:false}]); const items = [...document.querySelectorAll('body > .sbm-block .sbm-item')]; return items.length + ':' + items.map((i) => i.dataset.tabId).join('>'); })()

(() => { const block = document.querySelector('body > .sbm-block'); const item = block.querySelector('.sbm-item').getBoundingClientRect(); const dots = document.querySelector('.spacedots'); const clear = !dots || block.getBoundingClientRect().bottom <= dots.getBoundingClientRect().top + 1; return Math.round(item.height) + ',' + (clear ? 'clear' : 'overlaps'); })()

(() => { const item = document.querySelector('body > .sbm-block .sbm-item'); const hidden = (sel) => getComputedStyle(item.querySelector(sel)).display === 'none'; const up = ['.sbm-fv', '.sbm-prev', '.sbm-play', '.sbm-next', '.sbm-vol-btn'].every((sel) => !hidden(sel)); const down = ['.sbm-title', '.sbm-pip-btn', '.sbm-close-btn'].every(hidden); return (up ? 'transport-in' : 'transport-out') + ',' + (down ? 'title-out' : 'title-in'); })()

(() => { const first = document.querySelectorAll('body > .sbm-block .sbm-item')[0]; const names = [...first.querySelectorAll('.sbm-btn[data-command]')].map((b) => b.dataset.command).join(','); return names + '|' + (first.querySelector('.sbm-prev').disabled ? 'dim' : 'live'); })()

(() => { const sent = []; const real = chrome.send; chrome.send = (n, a) => sent.push(n + ':' + a[0]); const item = document.querySelectorAll('body > .sbm-block .sbm-item')[1]; for (const name of ['mediaPrev','mediaPlayPause','mediaNext','mediaPictureInPicture','mediaClosed']) { item.querySelector('.sbm-btn[data-command="' + name + '"]').click(); } chrome.send = real; return sent.join(' '); })()

(() => { const sent = []; const real = chrome.send; chrome.send = (n, a) => sent.push(n + ':' + a.join(',')); const item = document.querySelectorAll('body > .sbm-block .sbm-item')[1]; item.querySelector('.sbm-title').click(); item.querySelector('.sbm-vol-btn').click(); const range = item.querySelector('.sbm-vol-range'); range.value = '0.4'; range.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); chrome.send = real; return sent.join(' '); })()

(() => { const item = document.querySelectorAll('body > .sbm-block .sbm-item')[1]; const band = item.querySelector('.sbm-volband'); return Math.round(item.getBoundingClientRect().height) + ',' + (getComputedStyle(band).display === 'none' ? 'band-out' : 'band-in'); })()

(() => { const item = document.querySelectorAll('body > .sbm-block .sbm-item')[1]; const box = item.getBoundingClientRect(); const style = getComputedStyle(item); const lead = item.querySelector('.sbm-fv').getBoundingClientRect().left - (box.left + parseFloat(style.paddingLeft)); const trail = (box.right - parseFloat(style.paddingRight)) - item.querySelector('.sbm-vol-btn').getBoundingClientRect().right; const full = Math.abs(lead) <= 1 && Math.abs(trail) <= 1; const face = getComputedStyle(item.querySelector('.sbm-title')).fontFamily; return (full ? 'full-width' : 'inset:' + Math.round(lead) + '/' + Math.round(trail)) + ',' + (/sans|system-ui|-apple-system/i.test(face) ? 'sans' : face); })()

(() => { const item = document.querySelectorAll('body > .sbm-block .sbm-item')[1]; const top = item.getBoundingClientRect().top; const mid = (sel) => { const r = item.querySelector(sel).getBoundingClientRect(); return Math.round((r.top + r.bottom) / 2 - top); }; return mid('.sbm-title') + ',' + mid('.sbm-play') + ',' + mid('.sbm-vol-range'); })()

(() => { const block = document.querySelector('body > .sbm-block'); const item = document.querySelectorAll('body > .sbm-block .sbm-item')[1]; const was = block.style.width; block.style.width = '144px'; item.getBoundingClientRect(); const box = item.getBoundingClientRect(); const r = (s) => item.querySelector(s).getBoundingClientRect(); const lead = r('.sbm-prev').left - box.left; const trail = box.right - r('.sbm-vol-btn').right; const g1 = r('.sbm-play').left - r('.sbm-prev').right; const g2 = r('.sbm-next').left - r('.sbm-play').right; const g3 = r('.sbm-vol-btn').left - r('.sbm-next').right; block.style.width = was; const all = [lead, g1, g2, g3, trail]; const even = all.every((v) => Math.abs(v - all[0]) <= 1); return (even ? 'even' : all.map((v) => Math.round(v)).join('/')) + ',' + Math.round(all[0]); })()

(() => { const block = document.querySelector('body > .sbm-block'); const item = block.querySelectorAll('.sbm-item')[1]; item.dataset.mark = 'kept'; window.atriumMediaSessionsChanged([{id:'98',title:'Older Track',faviconURL:'',host:'one.example',playing:true,muted:false,canPrev:false,canNext:true,canSeek:false,pictureInPicture:false},{id:'99',title:'Newer Track',faviconURL:'',host:'two.example',playing:false,muted:false,canPrev:true,canNext:true,canSeek:false,pictureInPicture:false}]); const after = block.querySelectorAll('.sbm-item')[1]; return (after.dataset.mark || 'rebuilt') + ',' + (after.classList.contains('sbm-vol-open') ? 'open' : 'closed') + ',' + after.querySelector('.sbm-play').title; })()
(() => { window.atriumDismissMenus(); const item = document.querySelectorAll('body > .sbm-block .sbm-item')[1]; return item.classList.contains('sbm-vol-open') ? 'still-open' : 'closed'; })()

(() => { window.atriumMediaSessionsChanged([{id:'99',title:'Newer Track',faviconURL:'',host:'two.example',playing:false,muted:false,canPrev:true,canNext:true,canSeek:false,pictureInPicture:false}]); const items = [...document.querySelectorAll('body > .sbm-block .sbm-item')]; return items.length + ':' + items.map((i) => i.dataset.tabId).join('>'); })()

(() => { window.atriumMediaSessionsChanged([]); const block = document.querySelector('body > .sbm-block'); const root = document.getElementById('atrium-root'); return block.querySelectorAll('.sbm-item').length + ',' + (block.classList.contains('sbm-hidden') ? 'hidden' : 'shown') + ',' + (root.classList.contains('sbm-reflow') ? 'lane' : 'no-lane'); })()

assertions.desc: One controller per record, newest at the bottom
a controller rests at one 36px tab row and the block clears the space dots bar
the transport is the resting row; the title and the window controls belong to the expanded state
The live theme resolves a fill and an ink for the block
a record with no previous track keeps the button in place, disabled
Every control sends its own command with its own tab id
The title is the back-to-tab target and the slider sends a level
The volume slider grows a third band in the block, not a popover
the transport fills the row from the favicon to the volume button, in the sidebar sans face
each band centres its own contents, and the volume band opens under the transport
at the narrowest sidebar the space before the first button, between each pair and after the volume button all measure the same
a push that changes no row patches the nodes it drew and keeps the open band, but still redraws the play glyph
Esc and click-outside reach the band through the shared dismiss registry
The record that went took its controller with it
An empty push empties the block and gives the tab list its room back
